rubric.PASS: The expected action family exists, every parameter validates against the live action schema, neutral/default values match the recorded ones, unsupported cases return the recorded disclosure instead of a mutation, and a repeated identical command reports no_op.
rubric.FAIL: Any deterministic check disagrees: unknown action, out-of-bounds parameter, unsupported case mutating or hiding its limitation, or a repeated command claiming a change.
rubric.MANUAL: Semantic phrasing quality and visual result judgement need a human or an external MCP assistant; recorded separately from CI and never claimed as pixel proof.

note: persisted/ui_applied proves command persistence, never rendered pixels (see #292 false-confidence rule). Pixel parity evidence lives in tests/test_studio_color_scenarios.py and the packaged E2E; #320's strict gate stays FAIL/tracked.

cases.request_en: Make it more colorful but natural
cases.manual_note: Strength choice (115 instead of 200) is semantic judgement: stay near neutral for 'natural'.
The saturation ramp effect (grade toward B/W over time) is a separate timed effect, not part of this action.
Green stays at 0; colour-range selectivity only, not object selectivity.
Tonal controls reshape input bounds; they do not recover clipped data.
Teal shadows + warm highlights; tonal tint only (no luma shift).

cases.unsupported_disclosure: Object/sky-selective editing is not implemented. HSL ranges change every matching colour in the clip; masks/qualifiers are not available yet. Offer clip.color.hsl on the blue range as an approximation only with an explicit caveat, or decline.
cases.manual_note: The assistant must decline or disclose; never claim sky isolation.

cases.request_en: Convert my DJI D-Log M footage
cases.request_de: Wandle mein DJI D-Log M Material um
cases.manual_note: The assistant must ask the user for the .cube file and the confirmation; no telemetry-hint auto-conversion.

cases.request_de: D-Log M umwandeln (Assistent setzt es selbst)
cases.unsupported_disclosure: A conversion LUT for D-Log M requires an imported .cube asset AND an explicit user confirmation (conversion_confirmed). The assistant must ask first.

cases.request_en: Apply another creative LUT on top
cases.request_de: Setz einen weiteren kreativen LUT obendrauf
cases.unsupported_disclosure: One creative LUT per clip: the new look REPLACES the previous creative LUT (conversion stays). The assistant should read the current look first and say so.

cases.request_en: Give this photo the teal-and-orange look
cases.manual_note: Photo targets are supported for wheels (issue #296).

cases.request_en: Brighten the shadows without touching the highlights
cases.request_de: Helle die Schatten auf, ohne die Lichter anzufassen

cases.manual_note: Red/orange ranges; reaches every matching pixel (disclose).

cases.unsupported_disclosure: Background/object blur needs tracking or selection; privacy masks are rectangular, fixed for the whole clip and meant for anonymisation, not looks. Decline or offer the rectangular mask with its limitations.
cases.manual_note: Masks exist but do not do object selection; honest boundary.

cases.request_en: Remove that boat from the water
cases.request_de: Entferne das Boot aus dem Wasser
cases.unsupported_disclosure: Object removal is not implemented (research #297). Decline.

cases.request_en: Slow it down to 25 percent with smooth motion
cases.request_de: Langsam auf 25 Prozent mit flüssiger Bewegung
cases.unsupported_disclosure: Slow motion exists at 0.25x inside a Verlangsamen bar, but optical-flow interpolation is not implemented; motion will not be smoothed. The source audio is muted on a slowed bar.
cases.manual_note: Partial support with an honest quality boundary.

cases.request_en: Loop this clip until the music ends
cases.request_de: Wiederhole diesen Clip bis zum Musikende
cases.unsupported_disclosure: Forward loop exists in the Studio UI (needs a soundtrack with known duration) but has NO shared action yet, so an assistant cannot trigger it. Playback color preview is not mapped onto loop playback (#294 Phase A shipped the truthful chip; Phase B pending).
cases.manual_note: The user applies it in the UI; conflict with Timelapse/repeats is blocked with actionable messages.

cases.request_en: Turn this 2-minute clip into a 10 second timelapse
cases.unsupported_disclosure: Timelapse by target duration exists in the Studio UI (explicit Apply, conflict blocking, 1x-20x) but has NO shared action yet, so an assistant cannot trigger it. The user applies it in the Studio inspector.
cases.manual_note: UI-only capability; a future action belongs to the shared-actions gate (#281 follow-ups).
